age.reason: Both are age in years at diagnosis/surgery.

menostat.reason: Menopausal status; B codes Pre=0, Post=1.

tsize.definition_note: B only has size groups; A (mm) is binned to B's groups, so detail is lost.
tsize.reason: Tumour size, mm in A vs. three size groups in B.

tgrade.definition_note: A has grades I-III, B only 2-3; the grading scheme may differ between the studies.
tgrade.reason: Tumour grade; B has no grade I.

transform.expr: rtime if (recur == 1 or (death == 1 and rtime < dtime)) else dtime

time.definition_note: Conservative recurrence-free survival time as in the R survival docs: death after the recurrence follow-up ended is treated as censored at rtime.
time.reason: A single time to recurrence or death is derived from rtime/dtime.

transform.expr: recur if (recur == 1 or (death == 1 and rtime < dtime)) else death

cens.definition_note: Event = recurrence, or death without a recurrence (conservative rule).
cens.reason: Event indicator derived from recur and death.
